_comment: Shippable Claude Code settings.json snippet for the supervisor PreCompact hook. Inert unless SHANNON_SUPERVISOR_SCOPE is set; during a supervisor run it records that context compaction happened in the open run directory (<report_directory>/.in-progress/<YYYY-MM-DD-HHMMSS>/COMPACTED), so the report is assembled from the on-disk checker fragments and notes the compaction. Never blocks.
